'''Blastniff''' is a [[Fire]] type [[DPS]] [[Tatari]]. It evolves from [[Magmusk]] at 36 stars after completing their specific [[trials|evolution trials]].

==Overview==
Current Description: "The smallest movement could ignite Blastniff's fiery tail when excited. When that happens, get ready for a show complete with fire, smoke, and screams-explosions are an exquisite art, after all."

Blastniff is a rainbow rarity Tatari. Like all Tier 4 evolutions, it requires B Rating to acquire, therefore its feeding level cannot be below B rating for each stat.
